pasos.prompt: Game prop design of a medieval ceremonial brazier for the throne room of a castle, for an isometric escape room game, unlit. A wide shallow dark iron bowl with a thick rim and a light grey iron band with round rivets around it, resting on a short sturdy octagonal pedestal of warm grey stone blocks with a simple square capital at the top and a square stone plinth at the base. Total height about 1 meter, the bowl is wide and takes the upper third. Inside the bowl: charred black logs, black charcoal and grey ash, completely cold: no fire, no flames, no glow, no embers, no smoke. Same grey iron with round rivets as the reference chest. Chunky simple bold shapes, no fine engravings, no emblems. Seen in a three-quarter front view slightly from above, whole object visible and centered, symmetrical. Exactly the same stylized 3D toon rendering, soft shading, saturated colors and soft upper-left lighting as the reference image. Edges defined only by light and shading, no outline. Isolated on a flat uniform light grey background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
